title: ButtonLoading configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.ButtonLoadingAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

IsLoading.description: Shows the loading spinner and blocks interaction while true.

ShowLoadingAndLabel.description: Keeps the button label visible next to the spinner; otherwise only the spinner shows while loading.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
